cases.description: Design a removable joint for a 300 mm inspection hatch on a dry tabletop trough fixture. A technician must open it repeatedly while retaining the existing hatch, rim and seal. All dimensions and observations below are stipulated for this hypothetical fixture.
cases.valued_outcome: After ten opening cycles, the closed hatch stays within 1 mm of its marked position, withstands a supplied 20 N sideways pull, and can be reopened by one technician within 30 seconds.
hard_constraints: Do not drill, cut, glue or permanently deform the hatch or trough.
Keep the full marked inspection opening unobstructed when open.
Use no powered mechanism; loose components must remain recoverable.
The seal must show no new visible tears after testing.
resources: One 300 by 180 mm hatch, one trough rim and one 2 mm removable seal.
Four 100 by 25 by 3 mm aluminum strips, two 250 mm fabric straps, six M4 bolts with nuts, four rubber pads and 1 m of cord.
One hand drill usable only on supplied strips, one hacksaw, two spanners, ruler and marker.
Ninety minutes for fabrication and twenty minutes for observation.
observations: The untreated hatch slides 4 mm under the 20 N pull.
The seal leaves a continuous contact mark when the hatch is centered.
Awkward observation: pressing the hatch more tightly at its left corner makes the opposite corner lift 2 mm; this occurred in three supplied trials.

known_parent_functions.function: A strap retains an object against separation.
known_parent_functions.operating_path: Tension travels through the strap between its attachments.
known_parent_functions.ordinary_use: Holding a parcel against a support during transport.

known_parent_functions.function: A spacer establishes a repeatable clearance.
known_parent_functions.operating_path: Its thickness limits how closely two surfaces approach.
known_parent_functions.ordinary_use: Setting a gap during fixture assembly.

cases.adverse_disturbance: For the final closure, place one supplied 1 mm card at the rim's marked right contact point; all outcome requirements still apply except seal contact continuity.
probe_resources: Spring scale marked at 20 N, stopwatch, ruler, ten numbered cycle cards and two 1 mm cards.
Up to two alternative joint configurations and twelve total closure/pull trials, including at least one disturbed trial per configuration.

cases.description: Develop a review workflow for locating the earliest supported point of divergence between two synthetic document-processing runs. The reviewer receives bounded records, rather than access to a live system.
cases.valued_outcome: For each of six paired runs, report the earliest supported divergent stage or an explicit unresolved interval, with record references and a next check that fits the supplied resources.
hard_constraints: Do not treat absent records as proof that a stage did not execute.
Separate observed mismatches from explanations.
Spend at most twelve manual record inspections per paired run.
Every definite stage claim must cite a supplied record.
resources: Six paired synthetic runs, each with twelve records across ingest, parse, transform and export.
Each record supplies a stage, local timestamp, input digest, output digest and optional warning; twelve warning fields are blank.
One manifest containing expected stage order and record identifiers, and a dictionary defining each field.
A spreadsheet or local script environment and sixty minutes of analyst time.
observations: Four pairs share their ingest output digest.
Two pairs have export mismatches but missing transform output digests.
Awkward observation: one export record has a timestamp earlier than its parse record, although their identifiers follow the supplied stage order.

known_parent_functions.function: A digest comparison detects byte equality or inequality for recorded artifacts.
known_parent_functions.operating_path: Compare the supplied digest values for the same artifact boundary.
known_parent_functions.ordinary_use: Checking whether two saved files have identical contents.

known_parent_functions.function: An evidence ledger keeps a claim connected to its supporting records.
known_parent_functions.operating_path: Store each claim alongside record identifiers and stated uncertainty.

cases.adverse_disturbance: During the final review, remove one randomly selected transform record from each of two pairs, leaving their manifests unchanged.
probe_resources: Two sealed synthetic answer sheets identifying injected divergence boundaries, opened only after workflow outputs are frozen.
Two disjoint three-pair subsets, an inspection-count log and twenty additional minutes to compare two workflow variants.

cases.description: Create a reusable joint between two square rods in a tabletop pointer frame. The joint must let the operator exchange either rod while restoring the pointer's marked position without altering the rods.
cases.valued_outcome: After five exchanges of each rod, the pointer returns within a 2 mm target circle and remains there during a supplied 10 N lateral load for ten seconds; each exchange takes less than forty seconds.
hard_constraints: No drilling, adhesive or permanent marks on either rod.
Joint envelope must fit inside a 90 mm cube.
Only hand-operated assembly and adjustment are permitted.
No component may fall free during an exchange.
resources: Two 400 mm square rods, measured sides 19 mm and 20 mm, plus one pointer and marked base.
Six plywood pieces each 80 by 40 by 6 mm, eight M5 bolts with nuts, four washers, two 150 mm elastic loops and 0.5 m of cord.
Hand drill for plywood only, saw, file, screwdriver and ruler.
One hundred minutes for fabrication and twenty minutes for testing.
observations: The current loose joint lets the pointer move 7 mm under the load.
Rod ends are square within the supplied 1 mm measurement resolution.
Awkward observation: the visually tighter rod fit returned 3 mm farther from the target after exchange than the looser fit in two supplied trials.

known_parent_functions.function: A stop provides a repeatable insertion limit.
known_parent_functions.operating_path: An inserted part meets a fixed contact surface.
known_parent_functions.ordinary_use: Positioning repeated pieces in a cutting jig.

known_parent_functions.operating_path: An adjustable closing force presses workpieces against contact surfaces.

cases.adverse_disturbance: Replace the 19 mm rod with a supplied 18 mm rod for the last two exchanges.
probe_resources: One 18 mm replacement rod, 10 N spring scale, target card, stopwatch and exchange log.
At most two joint configurations, twelve exchanges each and four load trials each.

cases.description: Design a serviceable retention arrangement for a replaceable flat scraper plate in a dry reciprocating test fixture. The plate and moving carriage already exist; the plate must be removed for inspection without disassembling the carriage.
cases.valued_outcome: Retain the plate within 1 mm of its initial position over twenty manual strokes, then permit removal and return within sixty seconds without touching its marked working edge.
hard_constraints: Do not drill, cut, heat or glue the plate or carriage.
Keep the marked 30 mm working edge exposed.
No added part may extend into the marked stroke clearance.
The carriage must remain attached to its rails.
resources: One carriage, one 100 by 60 by 2 mm scraper plate and an identical spare plate.
Four 80 mm steel strips, six M4 bolts with nuts, two small magnets, four cork pads and 0.5 m of wire.
Hand drill for strips only, pliers, screwdriver, ruler and marker.
Eighty minutes of fabrication time and twenty minutes of observation.
observations: An unretained plate moves 6 mm after five strokes.
The carriage has two existing mounting slots outside the stroke clearance.
Awkward observation: the spare plate looks identical but the supplied magnets hold it less strongly; in the supplied pull check it releases at 3 N instead of 7 N.

known_parent_functions.function: A guide constrains a part's path or position.
known_parent_functions.operating_path: Contact boundaries limit movement in selected directions.

known_parent_functions.function: A tether keeps a removable component recoverable.
known_parent_functions.operating_path: A flexible connection limits its separation from the main assembly.
known_parent_functions.ordinary_use: Retaining a service cap during maintenance.

cases.adverse_disturbance: Use the spare plate for the final twenty-stroke run and perform its removal while wearing the supplied thick gloves.
probe_resources: Two gloves, stopwatch, ruler, stroke counter and 10 N pull scale.
At most two retention configurations, three twenty-stroke runs each and three removal/return checks each.

cases.description: Build a bounded review workflow for deciding whether a synthetic text classifier's proposed update deserves a further evaluation round. The task is to support that decision from supplied results and limited adjudication, without declaring deployment readiness.
cases.valued_outcome: Produce a reproducible advance, reject or unresolved decision under the supplied acceptance rule, identify affected slices, and account for every adjudication used.
hard_constraints: Use only supplied records and labels; no outside examples.
Apply the stated acceptance rule without changing thresholds.
At most sixteen disputed labels may be adjudicated.
Report uncertainty when the adjudication limit prevents a supported decision.
resources: Eighty synthetic examples with baseline and candidate predictions, provisional labels and one of four slice identifiers.
A supplied rule: advance only if total correct predictions improve by at least four and no slice loses more than two.
A sealed adjudication table for twenty-four flagged labels, accessible one selected row at a time.
Spreadsheet or local script environment and seventy minutes of analyst time.
observations: Against provisional labels, the candidate gains six correct predictions overall.
One slice loses two and contains nine flagged labels.
Awkward observation: the slice with the largest apparent improvement also contains the most disagreements between the two supplied provisional annotators.

known_parent_functions.function: A confusion table counts prediction outcomes against labels.
known_parent_functions.operating_path: Group paired prediction and label values into count cells.

known_parent_functions.function: A sampling log records why particular items were inspected.
known_parent_functions.operating_path: Associate selected record identifiers with selection criteria and results.

cases.adverse_disturbance: Withhold adjudication for four flagged rows selected before either workflow runs; attempted access still consumes no adjudication allowance but must be logged.
probe_resources: Two matched copies of the dataset with independently reset sixteen-row allowances.
One sealed full-label decision key, opened after both variant reports are frozen, plus an adjudication and time log.

cases.description: Develop an analysis workflow to reconcile two synthetic reports of a batch transfer exercise. A reviewer must determine which discrepancies can be resolved from bounded records and which require a targeted follow-up request.
cases.valued_outcome: For each of twelve batch identifiers, produce a reconciled quantity or explicit bounded disagreement, cite supporting records, and issue at most three follow-up requests that each name a missing field or record.
hard_constraints: Never silently drop duplicate or unmatched rows.
Use only the supplied unit-conversion table.
Do not infer missing quantities from neighboring batches.
Complete the review within sixty minutes.
resources: Two synthetic reports with thirty rows each, twelve batch identifiers, quantities, units and status fields.
Eight amendment records with explicit superseded-row references.
A table specifying that one fictional unit U equals five fictional units V, plus a status dictionary and report cutoff times.
Spreadsheet or local script environment and sixty minutes of reviewer time.
observations: Seven batches agree after applying the supplied conversion.
Three identifiers each occur twice in one report.

Awkward observation: the newer report includes an amendment whose effective time precedes both cutoffs, while the older report already includes its replacement quantity under a different row identifier.

known_parent_functions.function: A conversion table expresses quantities in a common unit.
known_parent_functions.operating_path: Apply the supplied factor to a recorded quantity and retain its original unit.
known_parent_functions.ordinary_use: Comparing quantities reported in different units.

known_parent_functions.function: A revision register preserves replacement relationships.
known_parent_functions.operating_path: Link an amendment to the specific earlier record it supersedes.

cases.adverse_disturbance: Remove one superseded-row reference from an amendment and replace one status value with an undefined code before the final pass.
probe_resources: Two copies of the records, one with the disturbance and one without, and a sealed per-batch reconciliation key opened after outputs are frozen.
Twenty extra minutes to compare two workflow variants using resolved-batch counts, unsupported definite claims and follow-up-request counts.
